long_biography.plain_text:
Wilbur Edwin ‘Ed’ Bosarge Jr. grew up in Mobile, Alabama, studied applied mathematics at Georgia Tech and completed a doctorate at Brown University. At IBM he worked on computerized navigation and guidance systems for the Saturn rocket program, then taught mathematics at Rice University. His early ventures applied mathematical modelling to geophysics and oil exploration.

Bosarge shifted that approach to financial markets, developing nonlinear predictive models and licensing them to institutional clients through Frontier Companies. He later co-founded Quantlab Financial, where automated, science-led trading became his defining commercial work. In later years he founded Black Beret Life Sciences, backing regenerative-medicine research and companies while extending the same mathematics-led, multidisciplinary approach beyond finance.
